notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.

Six sample styles; primary names are used (alternates exist for about 15 tabs, e.g. Choir Principal 8' / Salicional 8' (E), Octave 4' / Celeste 8' (E), Sesquialtera / Tuba 8' (EA), Mixture / Corno di Bassetto 8' (E), Cromorne / Trumpet 8' (E)).
The website prints the Great Fifteenth as 4'; entered as 2' (the Vivaldi 260 and every other Johannus Fifteenth is 2'). Check on your organ.
The Swell Sub Octave and Super Octave tabs are entered as Swell octave couplers.
Mixture/Cornet/Scharf ranks are not published (entered without ranks; Cornet entered at 8'). The 30-note pedal compass is assumed for this European model.

MIDI scheme: No public Vivaldi 360 manual; MIDI scheme from the Vivaldi 270/370 user manual (July 2020), MIDI specifications p. 55 (Vivaldi 370: Choir 1, Great 2, Swell 3, Pedal 4, stops 12; CC11 55-127): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/40162-Uk5ski29OCZFDIZtnxak4y0D80cgLWfpKHhM77uPyUp8hSlBFnmQ9JIxGdnOgCKa-0/Vivaldi%20270-370%20Usermanual.pdf
